- Do you require PO numbers in a specific invoice field (header vs. line item)? Our ERP expects a PO in the Invoice Header field and then an additional external reference in the payment memo — want to make sure things reconcile automatically.

Hi Elena — thanks for the attachments and the clear questions. Looping in Priyom (procurement) and Jonas (payops) so we can confirm end-to-end.

Short answers and next steps:
1) Remit/tag format: please include the PO in this exact format in the payment memo so our ledger auto-maps — "PO#: <PO NUMBER> | INV: <INVOICE NUMBER> | VENDOR: FELDCRFT". Finance needs the PO at the beginning of the string for automated parsing.

2) Invoice placement: we require the PO number in the Invoice Header field. If you also include it as a line-item reference that’s fine, but header-first is required.

3) Bank verification: we do a micro-deposit verification for new ACH accounts. Once you confirm the account and routing in the enrollment form we’ll send two micro-deposits. Confirm the amounts in this thread and we’ll mark the account active.

4) Required docs: we have your W-9 — thank you. Please also complete our supplier_enrollment_form.pdf (attached) and share the vendor-side mapping XLS if you have one (helps reduce manual work).

Attachments: supplier_enrollment_form.pdf (fillable pdf)

Priyom / Jonas — can you confirm whether wires are allowed prior to micro-deposit verification for this account? If not, we’ll plan ACH after verification.

Thanks — Naomi
